title: Transition maps between finite perfect adic coordinates
statement: With the marked finite quotient coordinates of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-marked-origin], consecutive finite quotient coordinates admit coefficient-restricted maps dK_n. Every dK_n is universal after pullback to an etale source, in the structured-arrow sense used by [lem-weil-pbc-derived-scalar-extension-local-systems].

source.place: Tags 09AL and 09C6, with the balancing input of Tag 06YY.

proof.text: Use the proved coordinate scalar-extension isomorphism at one consecutive quotient and the canonical comparison/scalar-extension isomorphism. Conjugating by the supplied e gives an isomorphism between comparison of the scalar extension of K_(n+1) and comparison of K_n.

The fixed-module comparison Hom bijection lifts the hom of this isomorphism to the etale category, since its target K_n is bounded below. Exact comparison commutes with homology and reflects sheaf isomorphisms, hence the lifted map is an isomorphism. The scalar-adjunction unit followed by its restricted hom is therefore universal.
Apply etaleSourceNormalization_universal to the obtained universal arrow on every etale source, and choose the arrows independently at each n.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AL and 09C6: descend a scalar-extension isomorphism using the bounded-below Hom bijection, then use the scalar adjunction; quotient balancing is proved in new-g3-finite-perfect-adic-coordinate-scalar-extension.
